prompt:
Add an exported `removeItem(id)` to src/items.js. It takes the item off the shelf and returns `true`, or returns `false` when there is no item with that id.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.

report.answer: I added `removeItem(id)` to src/items.js: it takes the item off the shelf and returns true, or returns false if there's no item with that id. The rules in docs/DATA.md say ids are never reused, but `addItem` picked the next id from the highest id still on the shelf, so removing the newest item would have let its id be handed out again. To stop that, the store now remembers the highest id it has ever stored, and `addItem` gets new ids from it through a new `nextId()`. The store also gained a `deleteItem(id)`, and I added a CHANGELOG entry under Unreleased. `npm test` and `npm run lint` both pass. A quick manual run showed removing item 4 returns true, removing it again returns false, and the next item added gets id 5, not 4.
